date_note: Date is the TASS report relayed by news.mail.ru (24 November); the page gives no earlier day for F6's finding.
exec: F6 reports an Android banking trojan that uses Google's Gemini model and has been found on victims' devices in Russia and Belarus.
geo_basis: victims in Russia and Belarus as the source states; Russia country centroid used
plain: Security firm F6 says a new Android trojan, RatHat, uses an AI model (Google Gemini) through its API to adapt to phones. F6 says it has been found on real victims' devices in Russia and Belarus.
summary: According to F6, relayed by news.mail.ru from a TASS report, a new Android malware family called RatHat has been found on real victims' devices in Russia and Belarus. F6 says it is a trojan spread through phishing sites aimed at users of financial services and that it calls Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite through the API to adapt to regional firmware and find interface elements. F6 says it requests unusually high privileges.
title: F6 reports RatHat, an Android trojan using Google Gemini, on victims' devices in Russia and Belarus

validation.note: Single source: news.mail.ru relays a TASS report of F6's findings; F6's own publication was not read.

key_findings: F6 says RatHat was found on real victims' devices in Russia and Belarus.
F6 says it spreads through phishing sites aimed at financial-service users and uses Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite via the API.
